title: Researcher forwards an alleged Ransone email, then vanishes

tellings.quote: And and so he forwards me an email, which is allegedly from Valerie, which

plain: An unnamed researcher, speaking on a podcast episode about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council, says that sometime between the 2010s and 2021 another researcher forwarded him an email said to be from a woman named Valerie Ransone. He says that person then vanished. He tells it as something that happened to him, a loose thread in a larger story about secret contact.
